ns2:course.label: Architectural Design and Urbanism
ns2:course.description: Building design in urban settings; including introductory urban design and site planning issues; urban zoning requirements; human-built environment relationships; life safety requirements; universal design and accessibility; architectural design methods and presentation techniques; required field trips. Prerequisite: ARCH 171, ARCH 172, ARCH 273, ARCH 274, or Consent of Instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ARCH 171, ARCH 172, ARCH 273, ARCH 274, or Consent of Instructor.
